verdict.rationale: CrewAI's docs call it an "open-source framework" that AMP extends, and the source is publicly hosted on GitHub at crewAIInc/crewAI, so a user can read the code. However, no evidence names the specific license or its terms. Missing for 10: explicit identification of the license (e.g., the LICENSE file or SPDX identifier) and any independent corroboration of the license terms.
